newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil warehouse workers to strike at Santos port.
newsitem.headline: Brazil warehouse workers to strike at Santos port.

text.p: Warehouse workers at Brazil's key port of Santos decided on Sunday to begin a strike at 1000 GMT on February 24 because of a dispute over backpay, a director of the Administrative Portworkers Union said.
"The strike is for an indeterminate period," Bento Marques Prazeres said.

Although only around 140 workers will be involved in the strike, the stoppage is expected to bring 90 percent of all import activity and 70 percent of export activity at the port to a halt, Prazeres said.
The port authority and the unions are scheduled to hold a round table meeting at 1800 GMT on Monday at the local labour tribunal in Santos, he said.
Previous strikes at the port have seriously affected shipments of sugar, soybeans, orange juice and other commodities.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
